lines.zh: 我踩在山道上，石头都碎。
lines.en: I tread the mountain path, and stones break.

lines.zh: 我一步一步走，身体很重。
lines.en: I walk step by step, heavy.
I patrol down the ridge.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在地上划出沟。
lines.en: My tail cuts a groove in the ground.
I come out of the pine forest.
I walk toward the smell of blood.

lines.zh: 我绕开一棵老树，没碰它。
lines.en: I go around an old tree without touching it.
My back plates are broad and cut the wind.
I turn slowly to face you.

lines.zh: 我走过恶地的红土，留下一路痕。
lines.en: I cross the badlands, leaving marks.

lines.zh: 我迈一步，就跨过一道沟。
lines.en: One stride carries me over a ditch.
I lower my body and charge.
I climb the rocks.
I stop and take a breath.
I crouch at the pass, looking below.
I whet my claws on the ground.
My teeth are long and blunt.
I smell rust in the air.
There are old cracks in my back plates.
I circle my territory.
I raise my head to the clouds.

lines.zh: 我记得被驯服之前的事。
lines.en: I remember before being tamed.
I crouch, storing force.
I needn't sleep; I only need to eat.

lines.zh: 我鼻孔里喷出的气，卷起尘土。
lines.en: The breath from my nostrils curls up dust.
I shake my head, and the plates clatter.

lines.zh: 我在坡上伏着，看下面的路。
lines.en: I lie low on the slope, watching the road below.

lines.zh: 我蹲着，尾巴一下下敲着山石。
lines.en: I crouch, tail drumming on the mountain rock.

lines.zh: 你站在我脚边，像块石头。
lines.en: You stand by my foot like a stone.
I lower my head at you standing there.

lines.zh: 你的武器在我眼里太细。
lines.en: Your weapon looks thin to me.

lines.zh: 你的汗味顺着风爬到我这。
lines.en: Your sweat climbs the wind to me.
You took a step back; wise.
My foot is thicker than your waist.
You're standing somewhere too narrow.

lines.zh: 我的背甲可以挡下你的箭。
lines.en: My back plates stop your arrows.
My teeth are blunt, but my strength is not.
I know that smell of yours.

lines.zh: 我把前脚搁在岩上，等你。
lines.en: I set my forefoot on the rock and wait.
There's a cliff behind you.

lines.zh: 你的手抬起来，我才抬手。
lines.en: Your hand lifts; only then does mine.
My eyes glow red in the dark.
Your hand is tightening on the weapon.
I grin, and it isn't pleasant.
A crack in my back plate.
I step back, and stones fall.

lines.zh: 腿上一沉，我差点跪下去。
lines.en: My leg buckles; I almost kneel.

lines.zh: 我从喉咙深处挤出一声。
lines.en: A growl squeezes out from deep in my throat.
I shake, and rubble rolls off.

lines.zh: 我半跪着，胸口一起一伏。
lines.en: I drop to one knee, chest heaving.
I drop my weight and steady.
The wound is small, but it hurts.
I lick the split.
I can still heave myself up.
The smell of meat on you is fresh.
I take one step your way.

lines.zh: 我闻到那块肉在滴血，别收回去。
lines.en: I smell blood on that meat; don't pull it back.
My belly's been empty for days.
One step back from you, one forward.
I open my jaws, then clamp them.
That smell pulls me forward.
I run my tongue over blunt teeth.

lines.zh: 我低头，鼻子凑到你手边。
lines.en: I lower my head and bring my snout to your hand.
I bring my chest down toward the ground.
The smell of blood is in my snout.

lines.zh: 那点东西值得我动一趟。
lines.en: That's worth the trouble of moving.
You hit me and go back far.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，把你挤到山壁。
lines.en: I turn and crowd you to the cliff.

lines.zh: 我的背甲一点划痕都没有。
lines.en: Not a scratch on my back plates.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚背，我一抬。
lines.en: You step on my foot; I lift it.
We collide, and the dust rises.
I step back, leaving cracks.

lines.zh: 你的盾撞在我身上，凹了。
lines.en: Your shield hits me and dents.
I shoulder past you.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫到你，把你带倒。
lines.en: My tail sweeps you and brings you down.
As you pull back, stones fall.
Another comes down the mountain.
Her back plates are brighter than mine.
We stand side by side on the ridge.
She rubs her horns on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我们一起守着这个山口。
lines.en: We keep this pass together.
She's even quieter than I am.
We gnaw the same bone.
Her steps are lighter than mine.
We keep the pass without a word.
Two great beasts, one ridge.

lines.zh: 我咬起一头野猪，甩了甩。
lines.en: I take up a boar and shake it.

lines.zh: 我把你的盾咬出一道口。
lines.en: I bite a notch in your shield.

lines.zh: 我拾起一块山石，抛了抛。
lines.en: I pick up a stone and toss it.

lines.zh: 我把整棵树推倒，拖着走。
lines.en: I push a whole tree down and drag it.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的武器，把它压弯。
lines.en: I bite your weapon and bend it.
I pick up a bone and crunch it.

lines.zh: 我把掉下的铁锭踩进土里。
lines.en: I press the fallen ingot into the soil.

lines.zh: 我叼起一具残骸，扔下山。
lines.en: I take a wreck and throw it downhill.

lines.zh: 我把你的帽子踩在脚下。
lines.en: I stand on your hat.

lines.zh: 我把一大块肉拖回洞里。
lines.en: I drag a big cut of meat to my den.
You've entered my pass.

lines.zh: 在这片山上，我闻得到你的热气。
lines.en: On this mountain I can smell your warmth.
I raise my head level with yours.
I've lifted this foot.
You're smaller and slower.
Your shadow trembles on the ground.

lines.zh: 山口的石碑是我的界线。
lines.en: The marker stone at the pass is my boundary.
I lower my body and gather strength.
Your armor won't stop my head.
I've taken the downhill path.
You've backed to the rock; perfect.
You won't last many blows.
I close in, step by step.

lines.zh: 你绕石头，我把石头撞开。
lines.en: You circle a stone; I knock it aside.
I hear you break a stone.
My snorting lifts the dust.
Climb high; I can follow.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴甩在前面，堵路。
lines.en: I swing my tail ahead to block the way.
I stop only to shift feet.
Your arrows don't pierce my plates.
One more step and I'm on you.
You're looking for a way back; I see it.
I raise a hand to block above you.
I'm running; don't move.
I headbutt; the mountain rings.
I bite down and heave upward.
Tron Flame pours from my mouth.
I lift a foot and bring it down.
I sweep with my tail.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的盾，往旁边甩。
lines.en: I grab your shield and fling it aside.
That knocks you into the rock face.
You blocked it, but slid back a pace.
My whole bulk comes down.

lines.zh: 它刚退，我的头就撞过去。
lines.en: It barely steps back; my head slams in.

lines.zh: 我的牙钝，这一下靠体重。
lines.en: My teeth are blunt; this one's all weight.
I whip my head and throw you.

lines.zh: 山上的雾散开，我站起来。
lines.en: The mountain fog parts, and I rise.

lines.zh: 岩壁裂开，我硬挤出一个身位。
lines.en: The rock face splits; I force out a body's width.
The stone here is hard enough.

lines.zh: 我一拱背甲，碎石滚下山去。
lines.en: I arch my back and the rubble rolls downhill.

lines.zh: 我从山坡站起来，抖落一身土。
lines.en: I rise from the hillside and shake off the dirt.
The badlands' red clay is under my feet.
I walk a little, testing my legs.
Someone's at the pass.
My plates are still caked with dirt.
First I stand high and look.
I walk down the slope, step by step.
This area answers to me now.
I hear something running.

lines.zh: 我站到路口，影子压过整条道。
lines.en: I stand at the pass; my shadow covers the whole road.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的甲，我甩了甩头。
lines.en: Fire heats my plates; I shake my head.

lines.zh: 我从山上滚下去，撞断了两棵树。
lines.en: I roll down and snap two trees.

lines.zh: 水浇在我身上，我喷着气。
lines.en: Water douses me; I snort.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀翻了我，我撑地起来。
lines.en: The blast flips me; I push up off the ground.

lines.zh: 一支箭插进甲缝，很麻烦。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in a plate seam; annoying.
A light winds around my legs.
My belly's empty and my legs are lead.

lines.zh: 电顺着背甲走，我甩头咬牙。
lines.en: Lightning runs along my back plates; I shake my head and clench my teeth.
No mountain here, and no ground.
